name: Tree Master
description: You are given a tree with $$$n$$$ weighted vertices labeled from $$$1$$$ to $$$n$$$ rooted at vertex $$$1$$$. The parent of vertex $$$i$$$ is $$$p_i$$$ and the weight of vertex $$$i$$$ is $$$a_i$$$. For convenience, define $$$p_1=0$$$. For two vertices $$$x$$$ and $$$y$$$ of the same depth$$$^\dagger$$$ , define $$$f(x,y)$$$ as follows: Initialize $$$\mathrm{ans}=0$$$. While both $$$x$$$ and $$$y$$$ are not $$$0$$$: $$$\mathrm{ans}\leftarrow \mathrm{ans}+a_x\cdot a_y$$$; $$$x\leftarrow p_x$$$; $$$y\leftarrow p_y$$$. $$$f(x,y)$$$ is the value of $$$\mathrm{ans}$$$. You will process $$$q$$$ queries. In the $$$i$$$-th query, you are given two integers $$$x_i$$$ and $$$y_i$$$ and you need to calculate $$$f(x_i,y_i)$$$. $$$^\dagger$$$ The depth of vertex $$$v$$$ is the number of edges on the unique simple path from the root of the tree to vertex $$$v$$$.
input_specification: The first line contains two integers $$$n$$$ and $$$q$$$ ($$$2 \le n \le 10^5$$$; $$$1 \le q \le 10^5$$$). The second line contains $$$n$$$ integers $$$a_1, a_2, \ldots, a_n$$$ ($$$1 \le a_i \le 10^5$$$). The third line contains $$$n-1$$$ integers $$$p_2, \ldots, p_n$$$ ($$$1 \le p_i \lt i$$$). Each of the next $$$q$$$ lines contains two integers $$$x_i$$$ and $$$y_i$$$ ($$$1\le x_i,y_i\le n$$$). It is guaranteed that $$$x_i$$$ and $$$y_i$$$ are of the same depth.
output_specification: Output $$$q$$$ lines, the $$$i$$$-th line contains a single integer, the value of $$$f(x_i,y_i)$$$.
approach_summary: Build a Segment Tree over the array. Implement point update and associative range query operations in O(log N) time per query.
